name: bella-notte-monorepo
description: Bella Notte — Pizzaria Artesanal de Luxo | Frontend imersivo + Backend de pré-atendimento

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "red,gold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
